meta.title: Elloumi Concept — Private training house
meta.description: Private training, limited membership. A calm floor, senior coaches, and a house built for serious training — by appointment only.

hero.body: By appointment only. A calm floor, considered equipment, and coaches who train professionals — not crowds.
hero.imageAlt: Minimal training floor with racks and soft daylight

items.title: Curated floor
items.description: A tight edit of equipment — each piece chosen for feel, longevity, and precision.

items.title: Senior coaches
items.description: No floor traffic. Sessions are private, paced, and built around your schedule.

items.title: Members-only hours
items.description: Quiet blocks reserved for the house — training without the spectacle.

items.title: Recovery, integrated
items.description: Cold, heat, and mobility as part of the program — not an add-on aisle.

gallery.heading: Rooms with intent — not a theme park floor
gallery.body: Each zone is sized for how members actually train: short walks between kit, sightlines kept low, and light that flatters effort instead of glare. These frames are from houses we admire; yours will be photographed on site after opening.
gallery.aside: Tours are private and unhurried. If you are comparing clubs, bring shoes — we would rather you feel the floor than read another brochure.

reservation.metaDescription: Request a private tour or consultation. The concierge will confirm by email.
reservation.heading: Request a private visit
reservation.body: We keep the floor calm — visits are scheduled, not dropped in. Share a window that works; we'll reply with a confirmed time or a close alternative.

form.successBody: The concierge will confirm your preferred window by email within one business day. If your date is urgent, note it in the message field next time — or call the studio directly.
